This report presents the SELEX-derived motif logos, DNA-binding specificity
trees, projections and affinity comparisons for the manuscript figures.
Figures 2 and 3 contain the main SELEX panels; Figures S2-S19 contain the
corresponding supplementary panels. Numerical source data and software
versions are provided at the end.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  dpi = 300,
  fig.retina = 2,
  dev = c("png", "cairo_pdf"),
  cache = FALSE,
  error = FALSE,
  fig.path = "outputs/publication_panels/",
  fig.width = 6.5,
  fig.height = 5
)

required_packages <- c(
  "FamilyCode", "pheatmap", "ggplot2", "dplyr", "ape", "phangorn",
  "ggtree", "Rtsne", "ggrepel", "EnvStats", "stringr", "digest"
)
missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]
if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste(
      "Install the required R packages before knitting Figures:",
      paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", ")
    )
  )
}

invisible(lapply(required_packages, library, character.only = TRUE))
source("Rfunctions/SELEXseqFunctions.R")
source("Rfunctions/SELEXseqFunctions_response.R")
source("Rfunctions/motifDNAScoring.R")
source("Rfunctions/scatter_forward_rc.R")

source_data_dir <- file.path("outputs", "manuscript_source_data")
dir.create(source_data_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
render_cluster_panel <- function(...) {
  result <- plot_response_cluster_panels(...)
  panel <- knitr::opts_current$get("label")
  if (!grepl("legend", panel)) {
    tree <- ape::as.phylo(result$tree_row)
    display_labels <- response_clean_labels(tree$tip.label)
    tree$tip.label <- gsub("[[:space:]]+\\((intein|GST)\\)", "-\\1", tree$tip.label)
    tree_text <- ape::write.tree(tree)
    exported_tree <- ape::read.tree(text = tree_text)
    stopifnot(setequal(exported_tree$tip.label, tree$tip.label))
    original_distances <- ape::cophenetic.phylo(tree)
    exported_distances <- ape::cophenetic.phylo(exported_tree)
    stopifnot(max(abs(original_distances - exported_distances[
      rownames(original_distances), colnames(original_distances)])) < 1e-8)
    writeLines(tree_text, file.path(source_data_dir, paste0(panel, ".nwk")))
    utils::write.csv(data.frame(Tip_id = tree$tip.label, Label = display_labels),
      file.path(source_data_dir, paste0(panel, "-labels.csv")), row.names = FALSE)
    utils::write.csv(result$r2_matrix,
      file.path(source_data_dir, paste0(panel, "-r2.csv")))
  }
  invisible(result)
}
```

## Binding models

Position-specific affinity matrices describe sequence-dependent binding
energies. For each sample, candidate models are evaluated against the HOX-PBX
seed, and the model, orientation and alignment with the lowest motif-matching
score define its specificity signature. The 12-mer spans positions 1-12;
the HOX-PBX 8-mer spans positions 2-9, and the HOX 4-mer spans positions 6-9.

```{r representative-dimer-inputs, include=FALSE}
HOXseed <- make_hox_seed()
representative_pwm_files <- list.files(
  "CnDmelHox/PSAMs",
  pattern = "PSAM.*\\.txt$",
  full.names = TRUE
)
representative_selection <- select_hox_seed_representatives(
  load_hox_dimer_motifs(representative_pwm_files),
  HOXseed
)
representative_dimer_motifs <- representative_selection$motifs
representative_names <- vapply(
  representative_dimer_motifs,
  function(x) x$name,
  character(1)
)
representative_12mer <- representative_dimer_motifs
representative_8mer <- response_subset_motifs(
  representative_dimer_motifs,
  2:9
)
representative_4mer <- response_subset_motifs(
  representative_dimer_motifs,
  6:9
)
```

    pattern = "PSAM.*\\.txt$",
    full.names = TRUE
  ),
  list.files(
    "CnDmelHox/PSAMs/AntHox6aReplicates",

  ),

if (length(projection_replicate_files) != 20) {
  stop("Expected 20 Response2 PSAM files for projection-error estimation.")

projection_replicate_selection <- select_hox_seed_representatives(

hoxa_projection_matrix <- response_tetrahedron_matrix(

  "HoxA1_human",
  "HoxA5_human",
  "HoxA9_human"
)
projection_error <- response_mean_full_motif_plane_euclidean(
  reference_matrix = hoxa_projection_matrix,
  replicate_motifs = projection_replicate_selection$motifs,
  anchors = hoxa_projection_anchors
)
hoxa_projection_targets <- c(
  "AntHOX1a_Cn",
  "AntHOX8_Cn",
  "AntHOX6a_Cn"

hoxa_projection_target_labels <- c(
  "AntHOX1a_Cn" = "AntHOX1a",

  "AntHOX6a_Cn" = "AntHOX6a"

```{r replicate-populations, include=FALSE}
full_replicate_files <- c(
  list.files(
    "CnDmelHox/PSAMs/AntHox1Relicates",
    pattern = "PSAM.*\\.txt$",
    full.names = TRUE
  ),
  list.files(
    "CnDmelHox/PSAMs/AntHox1aReplicates",
    pattern = "(intein|GST).*PSAM.*\\.txt$",
    full.names = TRUE
  ),
  list.files(
    "CnDmelHox/PSAMs/AntHox6Replicates",
    pattern = "PSAM.*\\.txt$",
    full.names = TRUE
  ),
  list.files(
    "CnDmelHox/PSAMs/AntHox6aReplicates",
    pattern = "PSAM.*\\.txt$",
    full.names = TRUE
  ),
  list.files(
    "CnDmelHox/PSAMs/AntHox7Replicates",
    pattern = "PSAM.*\\.txt$",
    full.names = TRUE
  ),
  list.files(
    "CnDmelHox/PSAMs/AntHox8Replicates",
    pattern = "PSAM.*\\.txt$",
    full.names = TRUE
  )
)
if (length(full_replicate_files) != 28) {
  stop("Expected 28 AntHOX replicate PSAM files before outlier analysis.")
}
full_replicate_selection <- select_hox_seed_representatives(
  load_hox_dimer_motifs(full_replicate_files),
  HOXseed
)
full_seed_scores <- as.numeric(full_replicate_selection$best_table$score)
full_seed_labels <- as.character(
  full_replicate_selection$best_table$gene_symbol
)
rosner_summary <- response_rosner_outlier_summary(
  full_seed_scores,
  k = 2,
  alpha = 0.05
)
excluded_replicates <- full_seed_labels[
  full_seed_scores > rosner_summary$threshold
]
expected_excluded_replicates <- c(
  "AntHOX6a-PBX-rep2_Cn",
  "AntHOX7-PBX-rep2_Cn"
)
if (!setequal(excluded_replicates, expected_excluded_replicates)) {
  stop(
    paste(
      "Unexpected Rosner outlier set:",
      paste(excluded_replicates, collapse = ", ")
    )
  )
}

full_file_labels <- vapply(
  full_replicate_files,
  parse_hox_gene_symbol,
  character(1)
)
retained_replicate_files <- full_replicate_files[
  !(full_file_labels %in% excluded_replicates)
]
retained_replicate_selection <- select_hox_seed_representatives(
  load_hox_dimer_motifs(retained_replicate_files),
  HOXseed
)

reference_pwm_files <- list.files(
  "CnDmelHox/PSAMs",
  pattern = "PSAM.*\\.txt$",
  full.names = TRUE
)
reference_pwm_files <- reference_pwm_files[
  !grepl("^AntHox", basename(reference_pwm_files), ignore.case = TRUE)
]
reference_selection <- select_hox_seed_representatives(
  load_hox_dimer_motifs(reference_pwm_files),
  HOXseed
)
retained_with_references <- c(
  reference_selection$motifs,
  retained_replicate_selection$motifs
)

response2_with_references <- c(
  reference_selection$motifs,
  projection_replicate_selection$motifs
)
```

```{r synthetic-sequences, include=FALSE}
scatter_probes <- c(
  "TGATTAAT",
  "TGATTTAT",
  "TGATTGAT",
  "TGATGGAT",
  "TGATTTAC",
  "TGATAAAT",
  "TGATCGAT"
)
RNGkind("Mersenne-Twister", "Inversion", "Rejection")
set.seed(42)
scatter_sequences <- generate_dna(
  2000,
  12,
  motifs = scatter_probes
)

anthox1a_dimer <- response_get_selected_motif(
  representative_dimer_motifs,
  "AntHOX1a_Cn"
)
anthox6a_dimer <- response_get_selected_motif(
  representative_dimer_motifs,
  "AntHOX6a_Cn"
)
anthox8_dimer <- response_get_selected_motif(
  representative_dimer_motifs,
  "AntHOX8_Cn"
)
scatter_1a_6a <- scatter_details_forward_rc(
  anthox1a_dimer,
  anthox6a_dimer,
  scatter_sequences,
  scatter_probes
)
scatter_1a_8 <- scatter_details_forward_rc(
  anthox1a_dimer,
  anthox8_dimer,
  scatter_sequences,
  scatter_probes
)
scatter_6a_8 <- scatter_details_forward_rc(
  anthox6a_dimer,
  anthox8_dimer,
  scatter_sequences,
  scatter_probes
)
scatter_panel_results <- list("Figure 3a" = scatter_1a_6a,
  "Figure 3b" = scatter_1a_8, "Figure 3c" = scatter_6a_8)
```

  "AntHOX6_Cn",

)
fig2_logo_titles <- c(
  "AntHOX6-PBX",
  "AntHOX6a-PBX",
  "AntHOX7-PBX",
  "AntHOX8-PBX",

for (i in seq_along(cn_dimer_logos)) {
  cn_dimer_logos[[i]] <- cn_dimer_logos[[i]] +
    ggplot2::labs(title = response_hm_logo_title(fig2_logo_titles[i]))

}
plot_response_logo_grid(

## Figure 2b: position 7 T-A-G projection

Base preferences at position 7 projected onto the T-A-G plane. T is at the
top, G at the left and A at the right. Bars show the shared full-motif
replicate discrepancy projected onto the three-HOX reference plane, as
defined in [Source data](#replicate-discrepancy).

```{r fig2b-position7-triangle, fig.width=7.2, fig.height=6.2}
plot_response_position_projection(
  motifs = representative_dimer_motifs,
  target = hoxa_projection_targets,
  target_label = unname(
    hoxa_projection_target_labels[hoxa_projection_targets]
  ),
  position = 7,
  error = projection_error,
  label_all = TRUE,
  show_axes = FALSE,
  show_title = FALSE,
  show_legend = FALSE
)
```

# Figure 3

Relative DNA-binding affinities are compared for 2,000 unique 12-mer sequences
generated with random seed 42 from seven 8-mer cores and random flanking bases.
For each sequence, affinities are summed over all binding windows in both the
forward and reverse-complement orientations. Scoring uses four N bases at
each end; an N contributes the least favorable coefficient at that position.
Each window is scored relative to the optimal sequence for its model, and
window affinities are summed without further rescaling. The same sequences
and scoring procedure are used in Figures S7, S12 and S13. Dimer models span
12 positions and monomer models span eight positions. Colors identify the
seven core sequences; lines show ordinary least-squares fits with an intercept.

# Supplementary Figure 2

DNA-binding specificity signatures projected onto the plane defined by human
HOXA1, HOXA5 and HOXA9. Panels a-c use positions 1-12, 2-9 and 6-9,
respectively. Each selected position contributes its X, Y and Z tetrahedron
coordinates. For the bars, each of four replicate differences retains all
36 coordinates and is projected onto the plane defined by the full
12-position HOXA1, HOXA5 and HOXA9 signatures. The mean of the four projected
Euclidean lengths is the common bar half-width in panels a-c; total bar
length is twice this mean. The same full-signature error calculation is
used for the 12-mer, 8-mer and 4-mer panels.

## Figure S2a: 12-mer projection

```{r figS2a-projection-12mer, fig.width=7.2, fig.height=6.2}
plot_response_motif_plane_projection(
  reference_matrix = hoxa_projection_matrix,
  targets = hoxa_projection_targets,
  target_labels = unname(
    hoxa_projection_target_labels[hoxa_projection_targets]
  ),
  replicate_motifs = projection_replicate_selection$motifs,
  anchors = hoxa_projection_anchors,
  posStart = 1,
  posEnd = 12,
  error = projection_error,
  label_all = TRUE,

)
```

# Supplementary Figure 7

Pairwise synthetic-affinity comparisons among the three human anchors and the
three directive-axis Nematostella HOX-PBX motifs.

**Figure S7a-l**

```{r supp7-human-cnidarian-scatters, fig.width=4.8, fig.height=4, out.width='32%', fig.show='hold'}
supp6_pairs <- list(
  c("HoxA1_human", "HoxA5_human"),
  c("HoxA1_human", "HoxA9_human"),
  c("HoxA5_human", "HoxA9_human"),
  c("AntHOX1a_Cn", "HoxA1_human"),
  c("AntHOX1a_Cn", "HoxA5_human"),
  c("AntHOX1a_Cn", "HoxA9_human"),
  c("AntHOX6a_Cn", "HoxA1_human"),
  c("AntHOX6a_Cn", "HoxA5_human"),
  c("AntHOX6a_Cn", "HoxA9_human"),
  c("AntHOX8_Cn", "HoxA1_human"),
  c("AntHOX8_Cn", "HoxA5_human"),
  c("AntHOX8_Cn", "HoxA9_human")
)

for (panel_index in seq_along(supp6_pairs)) {
  motif_pair <- supp6_pairs[[panel_index]]
  result <- scatter_details_forward_rc(
    x_motif = response_get_selected_motif(representative_dimer_motifs, motif_pair[2]),
    y_motif = response_get_selected_motif(representative_dimer_motifs, motif_pair[1]),
    scatter_sequences, scatter_probes)
  scatter_panel_results[[paste0("Figure S7", letters[panel_index])]] <- result
  response_draw_plot(result$plot)
}
```

# Source data

## Replicate discrepancy

Each full 12-position motif has a 36-coordinate tetrahedron signature.
Replicate differences use the complete signatures of four pairs:
AntHOX1-PBX, AntHOX1a-PBX (intein), AntHOX6-PBX and AntHOX8-PBX.
The AntHOX1a GST pair is not part of this estimate.

The plane defined by the full 12-position human HOXA1, HOXA5 and HOXA9
signatures has orthonormal basis vectors u<sub>1</sub> and u<sub>2</sub>, each
with 36 coordinates. For each pair, the full difference vector Δ<sub>i</sub>
is projected onto this plane, giving the length
d<sub>i</sub> = √[(Δ<sub>i</sub> · u<sub>1</sub>)<sup>2</sup> +
(Δ<sub>i</sub> · u<sub>2</sub>)<sup>2</sup>].
All 12 positions are retained for this calculation in every panel.
The common bar half-width is the mean of d<sub>1</sub>, d<sub>2</sub>,
d<sub>3</sub> and d<sub>4</sub>, and the total horizontal or vertical bar
length is twice this mean.

The position-7 triangle and the 12-mer, 8-mer and 4-mer projections display
this shared three-HOX-plane replicate discrepancy for all Nematostella
points. Point coordinates use the positions and reference plane specified
for each panel. The source tables include the 36-coordinate error-plane
basis, full replicate differences and their projected lengths.

```{r numerical-source-data, include=FALSE}
source("Rfunctions/validate_projection_coordinates.R")
projection_audit <- validate_projection_coordinates(
  representative_dimer_motifs, projection_replicate_selection$motifs
)
validation_dir <- file.path("outputs", "manuscript_panel_validation")
dir.create(validation_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
for (name in c("validation", "features", "coordinates", "bars", "replicate_pool",
               "replicate_pair_distances")) {
  utils::write.csv(projection_audit[[name]],
    file.path(validation_dir, paste0(name, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
}
panel_names <- c("Position 7 T-A-G plane" = "Figure 2b",
  "12-mer" = "Figure S2a", "8-mer" = "Figure S2b", "4-mer" = "Figure S2c")
publication_rows <- function(table) {
  table <- table[table$Panel %in% names(panel_names), , drop = FALSE]
  table$Panel <- unname(panel_names[table$Panel])
  table[order(match(table$Panel, unname(panel_names))), , drop = FALSE]
}
source_coordinates <- publication_rows(projection_audit$coordinates)
source_coordinates$Name <- response_clean_labels(
  response_display_labels(source_coordinates$Name))
source_bars <- publication_rows(projection_audit$bars)
source_features <- publication_rows(projection_audit$features)
source_features <- rbind(data.frame(Panel = "Figure 2b", Order = 1:3,
  Coordinate = c("X7", "Y7", "Z7")), source_features)
source_pairs <- projection_audit$replicate_pair_distances
source_pairs$Pair <- sub("::(.*)$", " (\\1)", source_pairs$Pair)
source_pairs$Sample_1 <- response_clean_labels(response_display_labels(source_pairs$Sample_1))
source_pairs$Sample_2 <- response_clean_labels(response_display_labels(source_pairs$Sample_2))
source_error_differences <- projection_audit$error_differences
source_error_differences$Pair <- sub("::(.*)$", " (\\1)", source_error_differences$Pair)
source_pool <- projection_audit$replicate_pool
source_pool$Name <- response_clean_labels(response_display_labels(source_pool$Name))
source_tables <- list(projection_coordinates = source_coordinates,
  projection_error_bars = source_bars, projection_features = source_features,
  replicate_pair_distances = source_pairs, replicate_pool = source_pool,
  projection_error_basis = projection_audit$error_basis,
  projection_error_differences = source_error_differences)
for (name in names(source_tables)) {
  utils::write.csv(source_tables[[name]],
    file.path(source_data_dir, paste0(name, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
}
```

```{r replicate-distances-table}
knitr::kable(source_pairs[, c("Sample_1", "Sample_2", "Projected_Euclidean_distance")],
  digits = 7, row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = c("Replicate 1", "Replicate 2", "Projected Euclidean distance"))
```

```{r projection-bars-table}
knitr::kable(source_bars[, c("Panel", "Half_width", "Total_length")],
  digits = 7, row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = c("Panel", "Bar half-width", "Total bar length"))
```

## Projection coordinates

Coordinates are expressed in orthonormal bases of the planes used for the
corresponding panels. CSV tables contain the coordinates, selected features,
replicate identities and error-bar values. Newick trees and pairwise
R-squared matrices accompany the clustering panels. Tree-label tables link
Newick identifiers to the labels displayed in each figure.

```{r projection-coordinates-tables, results='asis'}
for (panel in unname(panel_names)) {
  cat("\n\n### ", panel, "\n\n", sep = "")
  table <- source_coordinates[source_coordinates$Panel == panel,
    c("Name", "x", "y"), drop = FALSE]
  cat(as.character(knitr::kable(table, digits = 6, row.names = FALSE,
    col.names = c("HOX model", "x", "y"))), sep = "\n")
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

## Affinity comparisons

CSV tables provide the seeded DNA sequences, separate forward and
reverse-complement affinities and their sums for every model used in the
scatter plots. Coordinates, sequence identities and fitted-line coefficients for all
28 scatter panels accompany the model-level affinity and coefficient tables.

```{r affinity-source-data, include=FALSE}
utils::write.csv(data.frame(Sequence_id = seq_along(scatter_sequences),
  Sequence = scatter_sequences,
  Reverse_complement = scatter_reverse_complement(scatter_sequences)),
  file.path(source_data_dir, "scatter_sequences.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
utils::write.csv(forward_rc_affinity_source_data(),
  file.path(source_data_dir, "scatter_model_affinities.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
stopifnot(length(scatter_panel_results) == 28L)
utils::write.csv(forward_rc_coefficient_source_data(),
  file.path(source_data_dir, "scatter_model_coefficients.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
scatter_panel_table <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(scatter_panel_results), function(panel) {
  result <- scatter_panel_results[[panel]]
  data.frame(Panel = panel, X_model = result$x_model, Y_model = result$y_model,
    X_model_width = result$x_width, Y_model_width = result$y_width)
}))
utils::write.csv(scatter_panel_table,
  file.path(source_data_dir, "scatter_panels.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
for (field in c("data", "slopes")) {
  table <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(scatter_panel_results), function(panel) {
    data.frame(Panel = panel, scatter_panel_results[[panel]][[field]])
  }))
  filename <- if (field == "data") "scatter_coordinates.csv" else "scatter_regression_fits.csv"
  utils::write.csv(table, file.path(source_data_dir, filename), row.names = FALSE)
}
utils::write.csv(representative_selection$best_table,
  file.path(source_data_dir, "dimer_model_selection.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
utils::write.csv(monomer_selection$best_table,
  file.path(source_data_dir, "monomer_model_selection.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
input_files <- unique(c(representative_pwm_files, monomer_pwm_files,
  full_replicate_files, projection_replicate_files))
input_manifest <- data.frame(Path = sort(input_files), SHA256 = vapply(sort(input_files),
  function(path) digest::digest(readBin(path, "raw", n = file.info(path)$size),
    algo = "sha256", serialize = FALSE), character(1)))
utils::write.csv(input_manifest, file.path(source_data_dir, "input_files.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
panel_manifest <- utils::read.csv("Rfunctions/manuscript_panels.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
utils::write.csv(panel_manifest, file.path(source_data_dir, "panel_manifest.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Software environment

The analysis uses R and the packages listed below.

```{r software-versions}
software_packages <- unique(c(required_packages, "rmarkdown", "knitr"))
software_versions <- data.frame(
  Software = c("R", software_packages),
  Version = c(as.character(getRversion()), vapply(software_packages,
    function(package) as.character(utils::packageVersion(package)), character(1)))
)
utils::write.csv(software_versions,
  file.path(source_data_dir, "software_versions.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(software_versions, row.names = FALSE)
```
